about.title: About
paragraph:
I’m from Madagascar, where I earned a degree in Chemical Engineering. I took a job in the field of EHS (Environment, Health and Safety) where I quickly grew frustrated with repetitive tasks and manual processes.

I wanted to automate, optimize, and build tools that actually make work easier. That curiosity led me to coding which I learned step by step on my own.
Then a life-changing opportunity appeared : School 42 opened in my country. I made the decision to fully commit in learning computer science and software development.

Alongside IT, I’ve always loved art : drawing, painting, sculpting, and later UI/UX design.

Frontend development felt natural to me: it’s like drawing with code. Since functionality matters as much as aesthetics, I’m also actively developing my Backend skills.

Today, I’m a Fullstack Junior Developer who enjoys creating creative, efficient solutions for people who, like I once did, are tired of repetitive work and want tools that genuinely improve their daily lives.

42.description: Projects I've done during my study

projectList.periodic-table: Fun and interactive way to learn chemistry

projects.title: Likeo
projects.description: Likeo is a social media app that allows users to share their thoughts, photos with friends and followers. It features a user-friendly interface, real-time chat, and a variety of interactive features such as likes.
projects.contribution: I was part of the frontend team, implementing the user interface and ensuring a seamless user experience. I collaborated closely with the backend team to integrate APIs and optimize performance on the features : real-time chat, group management, search.

projects.title: Webserv
projects.description: Webserv is a web server built from scratch using C++ programming language. an HTTP/1.1 web server supporting GET, POST, and DELETE methods, file uploads, PHP CGI, and a file-based configuration system (routing and server settings).
projects.contribution: I developed some core functionalities such as request parsing, response generation, the CGI (Common Gateway Interface) for dynamic content.

projects.title: Inception
projects.description: Inception is a project that involves dockerizing a Wordpress application. It includes setting up a Docker environment, creating Dockerfiles, and configuring the necessary services such as MySQL and phpMyAdmin to run the Wordpress application smoothly.

projects.title: Cub3D
projects.description: Cub3D is a real-time raycasting rendering project that creates a 3D environment using a 2D map. It utilizes raycasting techniques to render the scene
projects.contribution: I worked on the 2D map parsing, and was in charge of the 3D rendering from the calculation made by my partner : sprite rendering, texture mapping, and interactions within the 3D environment.

projects.title: Minishell
projects.description: Minishell is a simple shell implementation that provides basic functionalities such as command execution, input/output redirection, and piping. It is designed to mimic the behavior of a typical Unix shell while being lightweight and efficient.
projects.contribution: I worked on the input parsing, error handling, signal management and the implementation of built-in cd command.
